role: original logical acceptance descriptions; not an engine, USD or module fixture

polarity.positive: the rule is satisfied and raises no error finding
polarity.negative: the rule fires with the listed finding

first_slice.true: implementable in the first slice (steel and the generic validator)
first_slice.false: reserved vocabulary: specification only, no behaviour

id_scheme: Element ids are 019a7bf0-0000-7000-8000- followed by 12 digits:
200000 plus the element number n of the case.
comparison: Identifiers, strings, booleans, integers and codes compare exactly.
Numbers follow CR-TOL-001 as in the F04 case file.
logical_keys: requires is the module manifest requires_vocabulary minimum; client and host advertise versions.
supported in enable_module cases is the common advertised set; expected.negotiated is selected.
penetrates targets are historical only when their source penetration is rejected or withdrawn.
post_delete_validation checks the candidate after removal with retained source records.
merge_provenance records transitions from their shared base state and sequence.
Expected status, primary_code, incomplete and truncated follow contract sections 6.3 and 6.4.
trusted_context.owner_level_permission is supplied by the host, never by an action field.
prior_transitions describe ordered accepted operations before the action, checked again at M.
Rule-pair cases isolate the named rule; reserved-kind cases remain specification only.
